name: Grey Hair
overview: Scripture honors grey hair as a symbol of wisdom, righteousness, and divine blessing, urging respect for the elderly as an expression of reverence for God (Leviticus 19:32). It portrays the hoary head as a crown of glory when found in the way of righteousness (Proverbs 16:31) and as the beauty of old men (Proverbs 20:29). The psalmist prays for God's sustaining strength even in old age and gray hairs to continue proclaiming His power (Psalms 71:18), while Isaiah affirms God's faithful care through all stages of life, including old age and grey hairs (Isaiah 46:4). Hosea's observation of grey hairs sprinkled upon one unaware underscores the quiet passage of time and the need for spiritual awareness (Hosea 7:9).
